name: No Right Turn
spec: white square with a black right-turn arrow inside a red circle with a red diagonal slash
meaning: Right turns are not allowed here.

snippets.back: Rectangular regulatory signs control traffic and direct your speed and direction, such as go straight or turn left, no U-turn, no left turn and no right turn.
A red circle with a red slash across a symbol, as on No Left Turn, No Right Turn, No U Turn and No Parking signs, means the action shown is not allowed.
After a complete stop you may turn right on red if no pedestrians or traffic are in the way, unless a No Right Turn On Red sign is posted.
A No Right Turn sign forbids a right turn at the intersection.
A No Right Turn sign prohibits a right turn.
A red circle with a slash across a turn symbol, as on No Left Turn, No Right Turn and No U Turn signs, means you may not make the turn shown.
A NO RIGHT TURN sign forbids a right turn at the signed intersection.
No Right Turn On Red prohibits a right-turn movement while the traffic signal is red.
